observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same beige tufted 2-seater sofa from slightly different angles.
The sofa has a diamond-tufted backrest and armrests, with visible wear and stains on the seat cushion.
The fabric appears to be a light-colored velvet or microfiber material, showing discoloration and dirt, especially on the seat cushion.
The sofa is placed on a tiled floor, with a metal staircase and some furniture in the background.
No brand or model is visible on the sofa in either photo.
